notes.note: Watson pulled up with a tight hamstring during the second. He did kick all 3 of his goals after that but didn't reappear after half time. He has already been ruled out for this week.
3 goals for Watson but 15 disposals at just 53%. The scores aren't there for us as he has had just 2 scores over 85 in the last 7 games.
After a good first half with 3 goals Watson had just 2 disposals in the second half as the Dogs took control of the game.
21 disposals and a couple of goals for Watson for his first 100+ score since round 1.

Second best score for the season with his best coming all the way back in round 1. Watson had just 12 disposals but kicked 2 critical goals and had 10 contested possessions. His impact was high which certainly influenced his score.
Watson kicked 3 goals but had just 9 disposals at 66%. He isn't a big possession getter and this was his lowest score of the season.
3 goals for Watson from just 11 disposals as he was flashing in and out of the game. His scoring hasn't gone over 80 though since round 4
2 goals from his 15 disposals. Not a big night for him but his scoring hasn't been as good as we would like.
Just 2 goals from 14 disposals for Watson this week. This is around the mark of scoring that we would expect.
Watson had 4 goals and 17 disposals. He was allowed to run around as he pleased against the Bombers. Don't expect this level of freedom from him regularly.
